艾洛诺儿从门里出来，脸上带着笑。

但他撑着扶手站起来的时候，苏璃看见他的手在抖。
苏璃进产房的时候，伊莲娜已经坐起来了。
她靠着床头，孩子躺在旁边的小被窝里。
她的头发散着，脸上还有没擦干的汗，但眼神清醒得很。
苏璃站在床边，低头看了看那个闭着眼睛的小女婴，再看看伊莲娜。
“出生证明、继承保护文书、财产隔离契约。”

“把伊莲娜书房第三个抽屉里那摞文件拿过来。”

她一手托着孩子，一手撩开小被窝的角，看了看里面的女婴。
小石头对着妹看了三秒，然后“哇”
伊莲娜靠在床头，表情里带着一丝得意。
苏璃站在中间，觉得这个画面和当年银杏巷那顿饭桌上的修罗场如出一辙。
只不过当年是两个女人吵，现在变成两个女人加两个孩子。
她把布袋递给苏璃，“我做了一个月。
没有攻击性回路，只能感知体温变化和哭闹频率。
温度低了会轻微发暖，孩子哭超过三分钟会震动提醒大人。”
苏璃打开布袋，里面各有一枚圆润的小木牌，木牌表面刻着极细的线条。
他把一枚挂在小石头的襁褓带上，另一枚放在女婴的被窝旁边。
塔莉娅赶紧从怀里掏出一份文书晃了晃，“上周就签了。”
塔莉娅的嘴动了动，到底没说什么，把脑袋缩回去了。

Elena: Do you still want it just after giving birth? (Elena: Do you want it just after giving birth? (Page 22) Shen En’s steady voice came from the delivery room, and Elena’s lowered voice said “Hurry up”
It may be because of experience, or it may be because Elena's physique is indeed stronger than Cina.
When the cry comes, the son of Bina is a little bit shriller.
Elonelle came out of the door with a smile on her face.
Only for a moment, and then he resumed his usual upright posture.
But when he stood up holding on to the armrest, Su Li saw his hands shaking.
When Su Li entered the delivery room, Elena had already sat up.
She was leaning against the head of the bed, and the child was lying on the small quilt next to her.
Her hair was disheveled and there was still sweat on her face, but her eyes were very clear.
Su Li stood by the bed, looked down at the little baby girl with her eyes closed, and then looked at Elena.
“Birth certificates, inheritance protection documents, property segregation deeds.”
Elena pronounced the three words as if reading from a menu, "Strike while the iron is hot, the signing will be completed today."
"Bring over the pile of documents in the third drawer of Elena's study."
... Saina came holding her seven-month-old son.
Little Shitou lay on her shoulder, chewed her fingers, and drooled all over Senna's shoulder.
She held the child in one hand, lifted the corner of the quilt with the other, and looked at the baby girl inside.
Xiao Shitou looked at his sister for three seconds, and then said "Wow"
Elena leaned on the head of the bed, with a hint of pride in her expression.
Su Li stood in the middle and felt that this scene was exactly the same as the Shura field at the dinner table in Ginkgo Alley.
It's just that back then it was two women arguing, but now it's two women and two children.
She handed the bag to Su Li, "I've been doing this for a month.
Without an aggressive circuit, it can only sense changes in body temperature and frequency of crying.
It will warm slightly when the temperature is low, and it will vibrate to remind adults if the child cries for more than three minutes. "
Su Li opened the bag and found a small, round wooden sign inside. The surface of the wooden sign was engraved with extremely fine lines.
He hung one on the swaddling belt from a small stone and placed the other next to the baby girl's quilt.
Thalia quickly took out a document from her arms and shook it, "I signed it last week."
Thalia's mouth moved, but she didn't say anything, and she retracted her head.
